## Before this can be merged

Artwork here is dedicated to the public domain under CC0, which means anybody
can use it for anything, forever, without asking. That only works if it was
yours to give away.

- [ ] **I made this.** Every piece is my own original work. It is not traced,
      re-coloured, or adapted from artwork, a photograph, a font, a game, a
      film, a brand or an emoji set belonging to somebody else.
- [ ] **I am dedicating it to the public domain** under CC0 1.0, and I
      understand that this cannot be revoked.
- [ ] **It contains no trademarks or logos**, and no likeness of a real
      person.
- [ ] `python3 tools/art.py check` passes.

If any box is unticked, say so in the description rather than ticking it
anyway — a piece that cannot be CC0 is still worth talking about, it just
cannot go in here.
